task.title: Run one paper RuntimeBinding through fleet execution to order, fill, and position

scope.owned_layer: Deterministic paper-fleet to paper-runtime normal-path proof, including durable fill/position readback and duplicate replay handling.
not_changing: live-capital activation, broker credentials, or shared deployment configuration

composes_with.upstream: L12-MIN-DEP-20260808 supplies a completed active paper RuntimeBinding.
composes_with.downstream: L12-MIN-TELREC-20260808 consumes the emitted paper-runtime telemetry event.

normal_path_proof.mode: deterministic, isolated in-process fleet worker integration
normal_path_proof.trigger: One active paper RuntimeBinding is returned by the fleet desired-state boundary and reconciled into one paper-runtime worker.
event_sequence: PaperFleetReconciler acquires its fenced lease and starts exactly one binding-scoped worker with the binding's runtime, pool, plan, and queue identity.
The worker resolves that exact RuntimeBinding, drains the produced canonical paper signal, and flushes its completed one-signal run.
PaperExecutionAlgorithm persists one committed paper fill and one position in its binding-scoped performance ledger.
PaperRuntimeService emits canonical paper_fill_simulated and position_snapshot runtime events through its telemetry emitter.

acceptance.statement: Start the paper fleet reconciler for the RuntimeBinding produced by Deployment.
Consume one paper signal and persist paper order, fill, and position readback.
Duplicate replay retains the original single fill and records duplicate_signal_id as a paper no-op.
Emit paper runtime events for Telemetry without enabling real orders or real capital.

safety.no_live_capital: pass; the test asserts is_real_order=false and is_real_capital=false on the emitted paper fill.
safety.runtime_binding_write_owner: Runtime Manager remains the binding authority; the test consumes an already active binding.
safety.deployment: not_applicable; this task proves the downstream Capital execution boundary only.

review.required_review: Verify the committed normal-path fixture, binding-scoped persistence, duplicate no-op readback, emitted telemetry event types, and no-live-capital boundary before approving this manifest through the governed status command.
